title: Apply the table: pilots read their model from the chosen result
goal: Pilot model assignment written to config only after the owner confirms the proposed table; shown in the models report with its evidence
acceptance: Proposal command prints pilot, chosen model, pack, pass rate and run date; nothing applied without the owner's yes
Example outcome checked against real evidence, not assumed: reminders gemma4:12b, coding qwen3-coder:30b, hard planning cloud Sonnet 5.5 only if local fails

A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
